behavior: Runner implements the frozen PrepRunner __call__(PrepJobRequest)->PrepProvenance; determine and verify implement the frozen typed Determiner and Verifier callbacks.

Codex Sol max/fast determination precedes Claude Code Opus xhigh/regular verification of that exact candidate and original evidence. The CLI JSON schemas contain fields only; code assigns source, candidate and verdict digests after strict parsing and required domain validation.

Host checks exact field inventory, source ownership, candidate shape and immutable values. CandidateValidator is mandatory, receives unvalidated flags, reads admissible evidence, and may change only schema_valid/evidence_valid. Unsupported validation remains invalid_output/unresolved.

Every verifier field needs an explicit verified/disagrees/unsure verdict, nonempty reason and owned evidence references. Verified fields must be sure, schema-valid and source-valid. Claude image jobs additionally require successful Read results containing bytes matching every original image snapshot.

Only a successful explicit disagreement permits one Sol reconsideration followed by one Opus reverification. Both rounds remain in the returned provenance and per-run runtime result. A verifier alternative is feedback only. Persistent disagreement, unsure or invalid output remains unresolved.

Only actual Opus execution failure in the initial round permits valid source-backed Sol fields to continue single_model_unverified. Failure classification, troubleshooting and diagnostic hashes are retained. Invalid output, missing metadata, resource refusal, source changes, or an earlier disagreement never authorize fallback. An emitted answer before a failed exit remains unresolved and cannot be discarded to claim fallback.

Only successful stage attempts are reusable. Cache identity binds pipeline/runner/domain versions, job and round scope, role, source, field inventory, prompt, output/validation contracts, candidate, actual criticism, requested model/settings, observations, explicit settings basis and final mode. Historical blind-reader records are never imported or promoted.

After fallback, cached Sol may be reused but Opus execution failures are never cached as successes; every subsequent launch attempts Opus again. Original cached execution timestamps are retained, and out-of-order cached stages are rejected rather than assigned invented call times.

A shared file/OS lock serializes entire prep jobs across threads/processes. Each actual child launch separately requires an external shared CLI-slot reservation including owner and child under four total processes. Per-provider cooldown and a global minimum interval persist under that same queue; no automatic execution/JSON-repair retry loop exists.

Commands expand accepted qualified argv without a shell; image switches repeat for multiple images and disappear for text-only jobs. Native CLI executables avoid unreserved shell/Node wrapper processes. All runtime snapshots, CLI homes/state/temp/cache/receipts remain under the assigned workspace development/testing split.

CLI account homes are explicit workspace-local paths, provisioned privately by the launch owner. Application API-key/auth-token variables and provider redirects are removed. No application secret file is read. Receipts retain measured usage, timing, exit/PID/settings and diagnostic hashes; raw provider stderr/auth transcripts are not published.

domain_integration.registration: JobDefinition(job, determination_instructions, verification_instructions, value_schemas, evidence, validate_candidate, validation_version)
domain_integration.value_schemas: Ordered mapping of fixed stable field names to CLI-compatible value JSON schemas; a change invalidates the output contract. Actual domain structure/admissibility must also be checked by CandidateValidator.
domain_integration.source_binding: PrepSourceIdentity.inputs must equal the supplied input keys and SHA256 of exact file bytes or canonical compact UTF-8 JSON values. source_ids maps every admissible field/row/number reference to one of those original inputs. Already extracted typed inputs and PNGs suffice; no PDF generation occurs here.
domain_integration.candidate_validator: The frozen CandidateValidator(candidate, source)->DeterminationOutput; use with_field_validation(candidate, {field_name: (schema_valid, evidence_valid)}) to assign actual host checks and rehash. Never change candidate values to repair output.
domain_integration.request_factory: definition.request(job_id, source_identity)->PrepJobRequest computes all prompt and output-contract digests in code.
domain_integration.runner_construction: Runner(jobs={definition.job: definition}, prep_settings=settings.data['prep'], workspace_root=..., runtime_root=..., reserve_cli_slot=..., executables=optional_native_paths, cli_homes=optional_owned_homes)
domain_integration.root_a11_resource_boundary: reserve_cli_slot() is a context manager backed by the actual native/shared reservation. Yield CliReservation(total_cli_processes including owner plus reserved child, owner_counted=True, child_slots=1), with total between 2 and 4. Use one shared runtime_root for all prep jobs. Runner deliberately has no fabricated/no-op resource reservation.
domain_integration.root_a11_auth_boundary: Privately provision the existing CLI-account authentication into owned CLI homes before actual prep. No app-key route, credential copying, login flow or live reader is run by this coding task.
domain_integration.publication: A11 remains the sole publisher of new generated prep outputs. Runner writes only explicitly selected runtime cache/receipts/results; it does not publish domain records or customer review state.

authored_tests.scope: Synthetic Python subprocesses exercise ordering, actual envelopes, code-computed binding, explicit field verdicts, bounded retry, mixed counts, invalid/unsure/unsupported handling, truthful partial observations/conflicts, cache invalidation/reuse/next-launch Opus retry, process cleanup/timeouts, cooldown, credentials, image delivery, and thread/process queue serialization.

actual_local_validation.kind: AST syntax/file inventory and Git whitespace/scope only
